label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. The unchecked database accident record (E1) is indirect evidence and is explicitly a clearance target after the first visit under the national criteria. The team's observation of unused land (E2) and the farmer's first-hand accident report (E3) also remain unexplained; technical survey is not available in this programme. This recommendation is about the required pathway, not a claim that EO has been confirmed.
flags: A person must review and sign off; this is a recommendation, not a final decision.
The zone flag and survey priority indicate where to survey and were not treated as evidence.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1, E2, E3.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: Unchecked database record is indirect evidence under the desk-study rule; its location and reliability have not been verified on the ground.

E2.quote: a field in part of the area has been left unused for years, with collapsed fences and overgrown paths, although the land around it is farmed.
E2.note: The survey team directly observed potentially productive land left unused; this suggests possible contamination but does not confirm EO or show safe use.

E3.quote: A woman farmer said a cow was killed by an explosion on the ridge about 2 years ago; she saw the place the next day and can show it to the team.
E3.note: This is a first-hand local report of an accident aftermath and identifiable location, suggesting EO presence but not itself confirming EO with certainty.
